G1c_range_accounting.positions_0_to_1e12_minus_1: outer q in [0, 1e6-1], 1e6 blocks of 1e6 positions each
G1c_range_accounting.note: 1..10^12 needs q = 10^6 for the single endpoint n = 10^12 (r = 0); 'one million outer blocks' is exact for [0,10^12) or for 0-based indexing.

G1d_bits.statement: q and r together carry exactly log2(1e12) bits of information; the two-level coordinates are a change of geometry, not a reduction of information.
